global: A rich, creamy tonkotsu ramen broth glistens in a blue-and-white “Shin” bowl, topped with vibrant green scallions. The spoon rests in the steaming broth, set against a warm wooden table under soft, inviting light.

regions.background: Wooden table surface with visible grain patterns and natural texture, showing warm brown tones and subtle variations.
regions.bowl: The ceramic ramen bowl has a blue and white patterned rim with repeating "Shin" text and small logos.
regions.soup: The tonkotsu ramen broth appears creamy beige, topped with vibrant green scallions, showing a smooth, slightly frothy surface.
regions.spoon: A black spoon with smooth, glossy surface and curved handle, partially submerged in ramen broth.
